what: One row per distinct non-government recipient of an action by an official on the Nov 3, 2026 ballot that directed or may have directed public money to it. Built by scripts/politics-money-recipients.mjs; rule in README.md.

fields.key: grouping key: the name without legal suffixes, punctuation or a d/b/a tail. Rows with the same key are the same name, not proven the same entity; an address or ID must confirm before a flag.
fields.type: 'organization' (name has an organization word) or 'unclassified' (no such word: may be a business or a person; read the record). Names that look like a person (first word is a first name seen on individual DOE contributions) are left out and listed in peopleLeftOut.
fields.addresses: only addresses an official record gives (action record, House CPF table, IRS file)
fields.actions[].counts: true when the official voted yes, requested, or acted; false when the minutes give no vote ('unknown')
fields.actions[].money: 'paid' when the record kind is a payment to the party (award, contract, grant, funding, change order, budget or earmark request, State land or easement purchase); 'unclear' when the kind can run either way (agreement, settlement, lease, land)
fields.actions[].funded: budget requests only: whether the request made the final budget (status in/notIn/vetoed and the amount)
fields.qualifying: actions with counts true and money 'paid'
